description: Executable Candidate text-only recipe for the exact NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni NVFP4 checkpoint on one Spark. It intentionally enables vLLM's language-model-only mode, so this identity advertises no audio, image, or video capability or hidden media dependency. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B-A3B NVFP4 text-only vLLM single Spark
